facts.fact: The ministry's GREEN guide states the Ministry of National Education has completed nationwide deployment of the IEN, a unique alphanumeric national identification number for every education actor, teachers and pupils, generated by GREEN at enrolment.
facts.system: IEN (Identifiants de l'Éducation nationale), generated by GREEN
